title: Narrative bind (story lock before DCF)
description: Written by Agent 5 before valuation_model.json on harness >= 3.0.0. status=locked is the compute-bind gate.

iv_playbook.description: REQUIRED on harness >= 3.1.0 (Python gate). One primary id from valuation_router.md: mature_operating | financial_service | real_estate | young_startup. Distressed and cyclical are overlays, not primary ids.

story.description: REQUIRED on harness >= 3.2.0 (Python gate). paragraph states the business story (>=20 chars).

3p.description: REQUIRED on harness >= 3.2.0. possible/plausible/probable must each be a non-empty list; possible strands are not in the DCF base.

map.description: REQUIRED on harness >= 3.2.0. Each key names a real input present in valuation_model (assumptions / wacc_buildup / terminal_consistency / roic_identity / explicit_forecast / street_bind); the value is the story sentence that drives it.
